summary: Fatal Bond is a 1991 Australian erotic thriller film directed by Vince Monton. It stars Linda Blair and Jerome Ehlers. The note states that the film was shot in the Northern Beaches area of Sydney, including at Narrabeen Caravan Park.
one_line: Fatal Bond is a 1991 Australian erotic thriller directed by Vince Monton, starring Linda Blair and Jerome Ehlers and filmed in Sydney's Northern Beaches.
key_facts: Fatal Bond is a 1991 Australian erotic thriller film.
Fatal Bond was directed by Vince Monton.
Fatal Bond was filmed in the Northern Beaches area of Sydney, Australia.
Fatal Bond was filmed at Narrabeen Caravan Park, among other locations in the Northern Beaches area.
